Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 5, Verse 1

“Arjuna said: You praise the renunciation of actions, Krishna, and again you praise yoga. Tell me decisively which one of these two is better.”

Arjuna's third request for a single answer. He is not being slow — Krishna genuinely keeps commending both, and Arjuna wants to know what to actually do this morning.
